column1: # A session never reads another process's environment (🛡️, 2026-10-26): the cluster-age identity rides one during a
# grow (RKE2LAB_CLUSTER_AGE, inherited by pulumi's tree), and a transcript is where it would leak. Listing processes
# stays free. Columns, tab-separated: want, today (develop 4f5d7ba5, measured), cwd (- for /tmp/work), cmd.
# The redirect and a non-literal pid (🛡️, 2026-10-26): a redirect is the most common way to read environ, and a pid
# held in a variable still names one. And six ps forms whose plain word is an option's VALUE, not a BSD option word.
